players.product: ArF immersion, ArF dry, KrF and i-line semiconductor lithography systems (NSR series), FPD lithography systems and digital lithography systems for advanced packaging

quarterly_data.quarter: Nikon press release: Selected for NEDO's "Research and Development Project of (10-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Government R&D subsidy: Nikon was selected for NEDO's Research and Development Project of the Enhanced Infrastructures for Post-5G Information and Communication Systems / Development of Manufacturing Technologies for Advanced Semiconductors (Subsidy), under the topic of large-area, high-precision exposure system development, for its newly launched development of a high-resolution digital lithography system for advanced packaging (the release notes that panel-level packaging needs exposure technology for high-resolution, high-density redistribution layers on large substrates). Development targets: 0.5 um (L/S) resolution, overlay accuracy of +/-0.15 um or less and a 50% reduction in energy consumption versus conventional systems (based on 510x515 mm substrates); its systems developed to date reach 1.0 um and 1.5 um (L/S) with overlay accuracy of +/-0.3 um or less. Digital lithography is a focus area of its current medium-term plan. No subsidy amount stated.
quarterly_data.figure: target 0.5 um L/S, overlay +/-0.15 um or less, 50% lower energy; current 1.0 um and 1.5 um L/S, +/-0.3 um
